content:
{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint definition inconsistent with BICR vs Investigator assessment",
      "quote": "Objective response rate (ORR), defined as the proportion of subjects with a confirmed objective response of complete response (CR) or partial response (PR) based on Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors version 1.1 (RECIST v1.1) as determined by Blinded Independent Central Review (BICR)",
      "page": 5,
      "section": "Synopsis - Study Endpoints",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The primary endpoint is defined as ORR by BICR, but the Methodology section states that response will be evaluated by both BICR and Investigator assessments, and the secondary endpoints include ORR by Investigator. This creates ambiguity about which assessment is primary for the primary endpoint.",
      "fix": "Clarify in the protocol that the primary endpoint is based solely on BICR assessment, and specify that Investigator assessment is secondary."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inclusion criterion 4c is illogical and likely a typo",
      "quote": "Documented disease progression in any lesion that was previously radiated in order to serve as a target lesion.",
      "page": 7,
      "section": "Inclusion Criteria",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The phrase 'in order to serve as a target lesion' is confusing; it seems to imply that a previously radiated lesion must have progressed to be eligible as a target lesion, but the wording is ambiguous and could be misinterpreted.",
      "fix": "Rewrite to clearly state: 'Documented disease progression in any lesion that was previously radiated, if that lesion is to be used as a target lesion.'"
    },
    {
      "title": "Contraception section referenced but missing",
      "quote": "be willing to use an adequate method of contraception (Section 4.3.2.)",
      "page": 7,
      "section": "Inclusion Criteria",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol references Section 4.3.2 for contraception details, but the provided text does not include that section, and the thin/missing list indicates 'M11 5.4 Contraception (missing)'. This leaves a critical safety requirement undefined.",
      "fix": "Add a detailed contraception section specifying acceptable methods, duration, and requirements for both women and men."
    },
    {
      "title": "Lifestyle restrictions not specified",
      "quote": "Subjects should have recovered (ie, Grade ≤1 or at Baseline) from radiation-related toxicities.",
      "page": 8,
      "section": "Exclusion Criteria",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not mention any lifestyle restrictions (e.g., alcohol, smoking, diet, sexual activity) that may be required during the trial, which is a missing section per the thin/missing list.",
      "fix": "Add a section on lifestyle restrictions, including any prohibitions or precautions during the trial."
    },
    {
      "title": "Trial stopping rules not defined",
      "quote": "All enrolled subjects will receive CMP-001 IT and nivolumab IV according to the treatment schedule until a reason for treatment discontinuation is reached.",
      "page": 6,
      "section": "Methodology",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not specify any trial-level stopping rules (e.g., for safety, futility, or efficacy), which is a critical missing section for a phase 2 trial.",
      "fix": "Add a section on trial stopping rules, including criteria for early termination due to safety or lack of efficacy."
    },
    {
      "title": "No definition of start and end of trial",
      "quote": "This study will be conducted at clinical sites in regions including (but not limited to) North America and Asia Pacific.",
      "page": 5,
      "section": "Study Center(s)",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not define the start of trial (e.g., first subject first visit) or end of trial (e.g., last subject last visit), which is required for regulatory and reporting purposes.",
      "fix": "Add a section defining the start and end of the trial, including expected duration."
    },
    {
      "title": "Access to trial intervention after end of trial not addressed",
      "quote": "All enrolled subjects will receive CMP-001 IT and nivolumab IV according to the treatment schedule until a reason for treatment discontinuation is reached.",
      "page": 6,
      "section": "Methodology",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not describe whether subjects will have access to CMP-001 or nivolumab after the trial ends, which is an ethical and practical consideration.",
      "fix": "Add a section on post-trial access to the investigational product, including any extension or compassionate use plans."
    },
    {
      "title": "Sample size determination lacks statistical justification",
      "quote": "The number of subjects planned for this study is 100.",
      "page": 6,
      "section": "Number of subjects (planned)",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol states the planned sample size but does not provide the statistical assumptions (e.g., expected response rate, power, alpha) used to derive it, which is essential for evaluating the trial's validity.",
      "fix": "Add a sample size determination section with clear statistical rationale, including assumptions and calculations."
    }
  ]
}
